capabilities.title: AI-Assisted Project Management
capabilities.text: Use AI in day-to-day delivery: turning meeting transcripts into minutes and follow-up emails, searching Jira and Confluence to explain project terms and tickets, creating and updating tickets and pages, and scheduling daily work summaries, inbox triage and reply reminders. I review all output before it goes out. I also built this website with Claude Code.

capabilities.title: Multi-Market Delivery
capabilities.text: Worked across CEE/SEE markets: a five-market webshop migration, a Slovenian webshop under EU VAT rules, and readiness for a regional fintech expansion under central bank and financial regulation.

capabilities.title: Stakeholder & Client Management
capabilities.text:
Managing client expectations and maintaining transparent communication
between business and technical teams. Experienced in facilitating workshops, sprint reviews, and steering meetings to align deliverables with business goals.

capabilities.title: Agile Cross-Functional Delivery
capabilities.text: Apply Scrum and Kanban to plan sprints, manage backlogs, and coordinate development teams and external vendors through testing and release.
